section.content: 提供一种能够预测制造时的三维造型物的变形的机器学习装置。机器学习装置具备：数据获取部，获取第一数据和第二数据，所述第一数据包含表示三维造型物的目标形状的形状数据和表示为了抑制制造中的三维造型物的变形而向三维造型物追加的追加部分的目标形状的追加形状数据，所述第二数据是与三维造型物的变形相关的数据；存储部，存储学习数据集，所述学习数据集包含多个第一数据和多个第二数据；以及学习部，通过执行使用了学习数据集的机器学习，学习第一数据与第二数据的关系。

Provided is a machine learning device capable of predicting the deformation of a three-dimensional shaped object during manufacturing. The machine learning device is provided with: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data representing a target shape of a three-dimensional shaped object and additional shape data representing a target shape of an additional portion to be added to the three-dimensional shaped object in order to suppress deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object during manufacturing, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of first data and a plurality of second data; and a learning unit that learns the relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set.

Machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning device.

Background

There is known a technique of forming a three-dimensional shaped object by laminating materials including powdered metal and ceramic, and then sintering the three-dimensional shaped object to improve strength. Since the three-dimensional shaped object shrinks due to sintering, deformation, cracks, warpage, and the like may occur in the three-dimensional shaped object after sintering. Regarding this problem, patent document 1 describes the following technique: the amount of deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object caused by heat is predicted using a finite element method, and when the predicted amount of deformation is not within an allowable range, the input geometry is corrected, and the three-dimensional shaped object is shaped in accordance with the corrected input geometry, thereby suppressing deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object.

Documents of the prior art

Patent document

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2017-530027.

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

In the technique of predicting the amount of deformation of a three-dimensional shaped object by using the finite element method as in patent document 1, when predicting the amount of deformation caused by heat of a three-dimensional shaped object having a complicated shape, which is shaped by a three-dimensional shaping device, it is necessary to set the mesh of an analysis model to be thin, and the analysis time becomes long. Such problems are common not only in the case of manufacturing a three-dimensional shaped object by stacking powdered metals and the like and then sintering them, but also in the case of manufacturing a three-dimensional shaped object by stacking plasticized thermoplastic resins.

Means for solving the problems

According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a machine learning device is provided. The machine learning device includes: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data indicating a target shape of a three-dimensional shaped object and additional shape data indicating a target shape of an additional portion to be added to the three-dimensional shaped object in order to suppress deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object during manufacturing, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of the first data and a plurality of the second data; and a learning unit that learns a relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set.

Description of the symbols

A 50 … machine learning system, a 100 … machine learning device, a 110 … data acquisition unit, a 120 … data storage unit, a 130 … calculation unit, a 140 … preprocessing unit, a 150 … learning unit, a 151 … reward calculation unit, a 152 … merit function update unit, a 160 … learning model storage unit, a 170 … prediction unit, a 180 … correction unit, a 200 … information processing device, a 300 … three-dimensional modeling device, a 400 … heat treatment device, a 500 … inspection device, and a 600 … display device.

Detailed Description

A. The first embodiment:

fig. 1 is an explanatory diagram showing a schematic configuration of a machine learning system 50 according to a first embodiment. The machine learning system 50 includes: a machine learning device 100, an information processing device 200, a three-dimensional modeling device 300, a heat treatment device 400, an inspection device 500, and a display device 600.

The machine learning apparatus 100 is configured by a computer including one or more processors, a main storage device, and an input/output interface for inputting and outputting signals from and to the outside. In the present embodiment, the machine learning device 100 generates a learning model by executing a learning process described later, and predicts a manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object using the learning model by executing a prediction process described later. The machine learning apparatus 100 may be configured by a plurality of computers.

In the present embodiment, the machine learning device 100 includes: a data acquisition unit 110, a data storage unit 120, a calculation unit 130, a preprocessing unit 140, a learning unit 150, a learning model storage unit 160, and a prediction unit 170.

The data acquisition unit 110 acquires the first data from the information processing apparatus 200, the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300, and the heat treatment apparatus 400 by wired communication or wireless communication. Further, the data acquisition unit 110 acquires the second data from the inspection apparatus 500 by wired communication or wireless communication. The details of the first data and the second data will be described later.

The data storage unit 120 stores various data such as first data and second data. The arithmetic unit 130 generates manufacturing error data to be described later using the first data and the second data. The preprocessing unit 140 generates a learning data set using the first data and the manufacturing error data. The learning unit 150 executes machine learning using the learning data set to generate a learning model in the learning process. In the present embodiment, the learning unit 150 includes: a reward calculation section 151 and a merit function update section 152. The learning model storage unit 160 stores a learning model. The prediction unit 170 predicts a manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object using the learning model in the prediction process.

The information processing apparatus 200 is configured by a computer including one or more processors, a main storage device, and an input/output interface for inputting and outputting signals from and to the outside. In the present embodiment, the information processing device 200 generates the shape data and the additional shape data by the three-dimensional CAD software installed in advance. The shape data represents a target shape of a body portion of the three-dimensional shaped object. The additional shape data indicates a target shape of an additional portion to be added to the main body portion in order to suppress deformation of the main body portion during production of the three-dimensional shaped object. The target shape is a shape targeted at the time of manufacturing of a product. That is, in the case where a product is manufactured in accordance with a target shape, the manufacturing error of the product is zero. When the target shape and size of the main body portion of the product a and the target shape and size of the main body portion of the product B are different, the target shapes of the main body portions are different. When the target shape, size, number, and arrangement of the added portion of the product a and the added portion of the product B with respect to the main body portion are different, the target shapes of the added portions are different. The shape data and the additional shape data are transmitted to the machine learning device 100. Further, in the present embodiment, the information processing device 200 generates the modeling data by causing the pre-installed slice software to read the shape data and the additional shape data. The modeling data represents various information for controlling the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 to model a three-dimensional modeled object having a desired shape. The modeling data is sent to the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300.

The three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 models the three-dimensional modeled object based on the modeling data. In the present embodiment, the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 is an adhesive injection type three-dimensional modeling apparatus. The configuration of the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 will be described later.

The heat treatment apparatus 400 performs heat treatment on the three-dimensional shaped object shaped by the three-dimensional shaping apparatus 300. In the present embodiment, the heat treatment apparatus 400 is a sintering furnace. The heat treatment apparatus 400 sinters the three-dimensional shaped object under predetermined heat treatment conditions. The heat treatment conditions include, for example, heating time, heating temperature, and the like.

The inspection apparatus 500 measures the dimensions of the three-dimensional shaped object after the heat treatment, and generates measurement data. In the present embodiment, the inspection apparatus 500 is a three-dimensional measuring machine. In the present embodiment, the measurement data represents the shape of the three-dimensional shaped object after the heat treatment. The measurement data may indicate the amount of strain, the amount of warpage, the presence or absence of cracks, and the like of the three-dimensional shaped object after the heat treatment.

The display device 600 displays the prediction result of the prediction unit 170 of the machine learning device 100. In this embodiment mode, the display device is a liquid crystal display. The display device 600 is not limited to a liquid crystal display, and may be a plasma display, an organic EL display, or the like.

Fig. 2 is an explanatory diagram showing a schematic configuration of the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300. The three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 includes a control unit 301, a table unit 302, a moving mechanism 303, and a modeling unit 304. The control unit 301 is configured by a computer including one or more processors, a main storage device, and an input/output interface for inputting and outputting signals from and to the outside. The control unit 301 controls the table unit 302, the moving mechanism 303, and the modeling unit 304 based on the modeling data supplied from the information processing apparatus 200.

The table unit 302 includes: a table 310, a frame 315 surrounding the outer periphery of the table 310, and an elevating mechanism 316 for moving the table 310 in the Z-axis direction. In the present embodiment, the lifting mechanism 316 is composed of an actuator that moves the table 310 in the Z-axis direction under the control of the control unit 301.

The moving mechanism 303 is provided above the table unit 302. The moving mechanism 303 supports the modeling unit 304, and relatively moves the modeling unit 304 with respect to the table 310 in the X-axis direction. In the present embodiment, the moving mechanism 303 is constituted by an actuator that moves the modeling unit 304 in the X-axis direction under the control of the control unit 301.

The modeling unit 304 is disposed above the table unit 302. The molding unit 304 includes a material supply unit 320, a flattening unit 330, a liquid supply unit 340, and a curing energy supply unit 350. In the modeling unit 304, a material supply unit 320, a flattening unit 330, a liquid supply unit 340, and a curing energy supply unit 350 are arranged in this order from the-X-axis direction side.

The material supply portion 320 supplies the powder material PD, which is a powdery material, onto the table 310. In the present embodiment, the material supply unit 320 is constituted by a hopper that stores the powder material PD. The powder material PD is a raw material of a three-dimensional shaped object. As the powder material PD, powders of metal materials such as stainless steel, steel other than stainless steel, pure iron, titanium alloy, magnesium alloy, cobalt alloy, and nickel alloy, powders of ceramic materials such as silica, titania, alumina, zirconia, and silicon nitride, and the like can be used. One of them may be used as the powder material PD, or two or more of them may be used in combination as the powder material PD. In the present embodiment, stainless steel powder is used as the powder material PD.

The flattening section 330 flattens the powder material PD supplied from the material supply section 320 onto the table 310. In the present embodiment, the flattening section 330 is constituted by a roller. The excess amount of the powder material PD pushed out of the table 310 by the flattening section 330 is stored in the material recovery section 317 provided in the frame 315. The flattening section 330 may be constituted by a squeegee.

The liquid supply unit 340 includes a liquid supply source 341 as a supply source of the bonding liquid BD, and a liquid ejecting head 342 for ejecting the bonding liquid BD from the powder material PD planarized by the planarization unit 330. In the present embodiment, the liquid supply source 341 is constituted by a tank for storing the binding liquid BD. The bonding liquid BD is a liquid containing a bonding agent that bonds the powder materials PD to each other. As the binder, various photocurable resins such as a thermoplastic resin, a thermosetting resin, a visible light curable resin that is cured by light in the visible light region, an ultraviolet curable resin, and an infrared curable resin, an X-ray curable resin, and the like can be used. One of them may be used as the binder, or two or more of them may be used in combination as the binder. As the solvent of the binder, water or an organic solvent can be used. In the present embodiment, a bonding liquid BD containing an ultraviolet curable resin is used as a bonding agent.

The liquid ejecting head 342 is a liquid ejecting head of a piezoelectric driving method, and includes a pressure chamber, a piezoelectric element for changing a volume of the pressure chamber, and a plurality of nozzle holes communicating with the pressure chamber. The liquid ejecting head 342 bends the side wall of the pressure chamber filled with the binding liquid supplied from the liquid supply source 341 by the piezoelectric element to reduce the volume of the pressure chamber, and ejects the binding liquid BD from the nozzle holes by an amount corresponding to the amount of reduction in the volume of the pressure chamber.

The curing energy supply unit 350 applies energy for curing the binder to the binder included in the binding liquid BD ejected from the liquid supply unit 340 toward the powder material PD. In the present embodiment, the curing energy supply unit 350 is constituted by an ultraviolet lamp. When a thermosetting bonding agent is used, the curing energy supply unit 350 may be formed of a heater.

Fig. 3 is an explanatory diagram showing an example of the target shape of the three-dimensional object OB. FIG. 4 is a cross-sectional view taken along line IV-IV of three-dimensional object OB in FIG. 3. The three-dimensional shaped object OB shown in fig. 3 and 4 has a main body portion MP and two additional portions AP1 to AP 2. In the following description, the additional portion AP1 is referred to as a first additional portion AP1, and the additional portion AP2 is referred to as a second additional portion AP 2. In the case where the first additional part AP1 and the second additional part AP2 are not particularly described in a distinguishing manner, the first additional part AP1 and the second additional part AP2 may be simply referred to as an additional part AP. In this example, the body portion MP has a zigzag outline shape when viewed from the upper surface. The main body MP has a first through hole HL1 at one end, a second through hole HL2 at the other end, and a third through hole HL3 at the center. The first additional portion AP1 and the second additional portion AP2 have a cylindrical shape centered on the central axis along the Z-axis direction. The first additional portion AP1 and the second additional portion AP2 are connected to the bottom surface of the main body portion MP. The first additional portion AP1 is disposed beside the first through hole HL1, and the second additional portion AP2 is disposed beside the second through hole HL 2. The first additional portion AP1 and the second additional portion AP2 are disposed so as to sandwich the third through hole HL 3.

Fig. 5 is a flowchart showing a method for producing the three-dimensional object OB according to the present embodiment. A method for producing the three-dimensional object OB shown in fig. 3 and 4 will be described as an example of the case of producing the three-dimensional object OB. First, in the modeling data acquisition step of step S110 in fig. 5, the control unit 301 of the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 acquires modeling data from the information processing apparatus 200.

In the molding step of step S120, as shown in fig. 2, the control unit 301 controls the molding unit 304, the moving mechanism 303, and the lifting mechanism 316 of the table unit 302 based on the molding data, and molds the three-dimensional object OB on the table 310. In the initial state, the modeling unit 304 is disposed on the + X axis direction side of the table 310. The controller 301 controls the moving mechanism 303 to move the modeling unit 304 in the-X axis direction. The control unit 301 supplies the powder material PD from the material supply unit 320 onto the table 310 while moving the modeling unit 304 in the-X axis direction, flattens the powder material PD supplied onto the table 310 by the flattening unit 330, ejects the bonding liquid BD from the liquid supply unit 340 to a position corresponding to the target shape of the three-dimensional modeled object OB on the powder material PD, and cures the bonding agent contained in the bonding liquid BD by the curing energy supply unit 350. The nth layer of the three-dimensional shaped object OB is formed by curing the binder. n is an arbitrary natural number. Thereafter, the controller 301 controls the moving mechanism 303 to return the modeling unit 304 to the position on the + X axis direction side of the table 310, and controls the lifting mechanism 316 to lower the table 310 by the thickness of the nth layer. The controller 301 repeats the above-described process to stack the (n + 1) th layer on the nth layer, thereby forming the three-dimensional object OB having the main portion MP and the additional portions AP1 to AP 2.

Fig. 6 is a plan view showing an example of the three-dimensional object OB placed on the mounting device ST. In the supporting step of step S130 in fig. 5, the three-dimensional object OB is taken out from the three-dimensional modeling apparatus 300 and placed on the placement device ST as shown in fig. 6. The carrier ST is a plate-like member made of a ceramic material or the like. In this example, the carrier ST is provided with two slits SL1 to SL 2. In the following description, the slit SL1 is referred to as a first slit SL1, and the slit SL2 is referred to as a second slit SL 2. In the case where the first slit SL1 and the second slit SL2 are not particularly described in a distinguishing manner, the first slit SL1 and the second slit SL2 may be simply referred to as slits SL. The first slits SL1 and the second slits SL2 have a longitudinal direction along the X-axis direction. The three-dimensional object OB is placed on the placing device ST such that the first additional portion AP1 provided on the three-dimensional object OB is inserted into the first slit SL1 and the second additional portion AP2 is inserted into the second slit SL 2.

In the heat treatment step of step S140 in fig. 5, the three-dimensional shaped object OB is subjected to heat treatment. In the present embodiment, the heat treatment apparatus 400 heats the three-dimensional shaped object OB placed on the placement device ST under predetermined heat treatment conditions, thereby degreasing the binder from the three-dimensional shaped object OB, and further sintering the three-dimensional shaped object OB. The sintering shrinks the three-dimensional object OB, thereby improving the strength of the three-dimensional object OB.

In the inspection step of step S150, the inspection apparatus 500 measures the size of the three-dimensional shaped object OB after the heat treatment step, and generates measurement data. The measurement data is transmitted to the machine learning device 100. After the step S150, the method of manufacturing the three-dimensional object OB is completed. Between the heat treatment step of step S140 and the inspection step of step S150, or after the heat treatment step of step S150, each of the additional portions AP1 to AP2 is removed from the three-dimensional object OB.

Fig. 7 is a plan view showing an example of the three-dimensional shaped object OB after the heat treatment step. Fig. 7 shows the three-dimensional object OB after the heat treatment process using the mounting device ST shown in fig. 6. In this example, since the movement of the first additional portion AP1 in the Y axis direction is restricted by the first slit SL1 and the movement of the second additional portion AP2 in the Y axis direction is restricted by the second slit SL2, a moment about the central axis in the Z axis direction acts on the outer peripheral portion of the third through hole HL3 in the main body portion MP due to the contraction of the three-dimensional shaped object OB in the heat treatment step is suppressed. Therefore, deformation of the outer peripheral portion of the third through hole HL3 is suppressed.

When the shapes, sizes, and arrangements of the respective additional portions AP1 to AP2 of the three-dimensional object OB or the shapes, sizes, and arrangements of the respective slits SL1 to SL2 of the carrier ST are not appropriate, for example, a moment acts on the central axis along the Z-axis direction as a center, and the shape of the outer peripheral portion of the third through hole HL3 is deformed as shown by a two-dot chain line in fig. 7, and the manufacturing error of the main body portion MP of the three-dimensional object OB may exceed the allowable range.

Fig. 8 is a first explanatory view showing a test result for examining whether the dimensional accuracy of the three-dimensional shaped object OB is good or bad. Fig. 9 is a plan view showing the sample 2 placed on the placement device ST. Fig. 8 shows the results of examining the dimensional accuracy of the main body MP for samples 1 to 4 of 4 three-dimensional shaped objects OB produced with different longitudinal directions of the slits SL1 to SL2 of the carrier ST. For each of samples 1 to 4, the symbol "a" is used when the manufacturing error of the body portion MP is within the allowable range, in other words, when the dimensional accuracy of the body portion MP is good, and the symbol "B" is used when the manufacturing error of the body portion MP exceeds the allowable range, in other words, when the dimensional accuracy of the body portion MP is poor.

The shape, material and heat treatment conditions of each sample 1 to 4 were the same. In the production of sample 1, as shown in fig. 6, the heat treatment process was performed using a stage ST in which the first slit SL1 and the second slit SL2 have a longitudinal direction along the X-axis direction. In the production of sample 2, as shown in fig. 9, the heat treatment process was performed using a stage ST in which the first slit SL1 has a longitudinal direction along the X-axis direction and the second slit SL2 has a longitudinal direction along the Y-axis direction. In the production of sample 3, the heat treatment process was performed using the stage ST in which the first slit SL1 and the second slit SL2 had a longitudinal direction along the Y-axis direction. In the production of sample 4, the heat treatment process was performed using a stage ST in which the first slit SL1 had a longitudinal direction along the Y-axis direction and the second slit SL2 had a longitudinal direction along the X-axis direction. The manufacturing error of the main body portion MP of the sample 1 is within the allowable range. On the other hand, the manufacturing error of the main body MP of samples 2 to 4 exceeded the allowable range.

Fig. 10 is a second explanatory view showing a test result for examining whether the dimensional accuracy of the three-dimensional shaped object OB is good or bad. Fig. 11 is a plan view showing the sample 8 placed on the placement device ST. Fig. 10 shows the results of examining the dimensional accuracy of the main body MP for samples 5 to 8 of 4 three-dimensional shaped objects OB produced with different arrangements of the additional portions AP1 to AP 2. In fig. 10, the symbol "a" or "B" used to indicate whether the dimensional accuracy is good or not has the same meaning as the symbol "a" or "B" used to indicate whether the dimensional accuracy is good or not in fig. 8.

The materials and heat treatment conditions of the samples 5 to 8 were the same. In the production of each of samples 5 to 8, the heat treatment process was performed using the stage ST in which the first slit SL1 and the second slit SL2 have a longitudinal direction along the X-axis direction. In each of samples 5 to 8, the center point Pa1 of the first additional portion AP1, the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3, and the center point Pa2 of the second additional portion AP2 were arranged in this order along the X-axis direction. In each of samples 5 to 8, the position of the center point Pa1 of the first additional portion AP1 in the Y axis direction, the position of the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 in the Y axis direction, and the position of the center point Pa2 of the second additional portion AP2 in the Y axis direction were the same. In each of samples 5 to 8, the distance Lh1 in the X-axis direction between the center point Ph1 of the first through hole HL1 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 40.0mm, and the distance Lh2 in the X-axis direction between the center point Ph2 of the second through hole HL2 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 40.0 mm.

In sample 5, the distance La1 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa1 of the first additional portion AP1 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 27.5mm, and the distance La2 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa2 of the second additional portion AP2 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 27.5 mm. In sample 6, the distance La1 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa1 of the first additional portion AP1 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 40.0mm, and the distance La2 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa2 of the second additional portion AP2 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 40.0 mm. That is, in sample 6, the first additional portion AP1 and the second additional portion AP2 were disposed as shown in fig. 6. In sample 7, the distance La1 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa1 of the first additional portion AP1 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 52.5mm, and the distance La2 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa2 of the second additional portion AP2 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 52.5 mm. In sample 8, the distance La1 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa1 of the first additional portion AP1 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 40.0mm, and the distance La2 in the X-axis direction between the center point Pa2 of the second additional portion AP2 and the center point Ph3 of the third through hole HL3 was 52.5 mm. That is, in sample 8, as shown in fig. 11, the first additional portion AP1 and the second additional portion AP2 were disposed. The manufacturing tolerances of the main portion MP of samples 5-6 were within the allowable range. On the other hand, the manufacturing error of the main body MP of samples 7 to 8 exceeded the allowable range.

Fig. 12 is a flowchart showing the contents of the learning process. This process is executed by the machine learning device 100 at the timing when the production of one three-dimensional shaped object OB is completed, for example. First, in step S210, the data acquisition unit 110 acquires first data. The first data includes shape data indicating an objective shape of the main body portion MP of the three-dimensional shaped object OB and additional shape data indicating an objective shape of the additional portion AP. In the present embodiment, the first data further includes material data indicating information on the material used in the molding step and heat treatment condition data indicating the heat treatment conditions in the heat treatment step. The material data indicates, for example, the type, physical properties, particle diameter, and the like of the powder material PD. When two or more kinds of materials are used in combination as the powder material PD, the types, physical properties, particle diameters, and content ratios of the respective materials in the powder material PD may be indicated. The material data may also indicate the type and physical properties of the binding solution, the content of the binder, and the like. The heat treatment condition data includes, for example, the position and the longitudinal direction of the slit SL of the mounting device ST used in the heat treatment process, the heating time, the heating temperature, the heating speed, the number of times of heating in the heat treatment process, and the like. The acquired first data is stored in the data storage section 120.

In step S220, the data acquisition unit 110 acquires the second data. The second data includes measurement data generated in the inspection process. In the present embodiment, the measurement data indicates the shape of the three-dimensional shaped object OB after the heat treatment step. The acquired second data is stored in the data storage section 120 in association with the corresponding first data. The order of the processing in step S210 and the processing in step S220 may be reversed.

In step S230, the calculation unit 130 reads the first data and the second data stored in the data storage unit 120, and generates manufacturing error data indicating an error between the size of the shape of the three-dimensional shaped object OB after the heat treatment process and the size of the target shape. The generated manufacturing error data is stored in the data storage unit 120. In step S240, the preprocessing unit 140 reads the first data stored in the data storage unit 120 and the manufacturing error data associated with the first data, and generates a learning data set.

In step S250, the learning unit 150 reads the learning data set generated by the preprocessing unit 140, executes machine learning, and generates a learning model. In step S260, the learning model storage unit 160 stores the learning model generated by the learning unit 150. After that, the machine learning device 100 ends the processing. The machine learning device 100 repeats this process every time the production of one three-dimensional shaped object OB is completed, and executes machine learning using a learning data set including data on a plurality of three-dimensional shaped objects OB having different target shapes of the main body portion MP, the additional portion AP, the powder material PD, and the heat treatment conditions, thereby updating the learning model. For example, the machine learning apparatus 100 executes machine learning using a learning data set including the following data, and updates the learning model: as in the above-described samples 1 to 4, data relating to a plurality of three-dimensional shaped objects OB having different heat treatment conditions, which are the longitudinal directions of the slits SL of the mounting device ST, and data relating to a plurality of three-dimensional shaped objects OB having different target shapes of the portion AP, as in the above-described samples 5 to 8, are added.

The algorithm of the machine learning executed by the learning unit 150 in step S250 is not particularly limited, and for example, known algorithms such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning can be used. In the present embodiment, the learning unit 150 executes reinforcement learning described later. Reinforcement learning is a method of observing the current state of an environment in which a learning object exists, executing a predetermined action in the current state, repeating a cycle of giving some reward to the action in a trial and error manner, and learning with a countermeasure of maximizing the total amount of rewards as an optimal solution.

An example of an algorithm of reinforcement learning executed by the learning unit 150 will be described. The algorithm of this example is known as Q-learning (Q-learning), and is a method of learning a function Q (s, a) indicating an operation value in a case where an operation a is selected in a state s, using, as independent variables, the state s of an operation body and the operation a that the operation body can select in the state s. And selecting the action a with the highest value function Q in the state s as the optimal solution. Q learning is started in a state where the correlation between the state s and the action a is unknown, and trial and error for selecting various actions a in an arbitrary state s is repeated, whereby the cost function Q is repeatedly updated so as to approach the optimal solution. Here, when the state s, which is an environment, changes as a result of selecting the action a in the state s, the weight of the action a, which is the reward r corresponding to the change, is obtained, and the learning is guided so as to select the action a that obtains the higher reward r, whereby the cost function Q can be brought close to the optimal solution in a relatively short time.

When the learning unit 150 executes Q learning, the operation of how to determine the target shape of the additional portion AP to be added to the target shape of the main portion MP in the current state corresponds to the update-type operation a, and the reward R obtained by the reward calculation unit 151 corresponds to the reward R of the update-type. Therefore, the merit function update unit 152 repeatedly updates the function Q indicating the merit of the target shape of the additional portion AP added to the target shape of the main body portion MP in the current state by Q learning using the reward R.

For example, the reward R calculated by the reward calculation unit 151 may be a positive reward R when the manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object OB manufactured based on the determined target shape is smaller than the manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object OB before the change after the target shape of the additional portion AP is determined, or the manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object OB manufactured based on the determined target shape is within an allowable range, or the like, and the reward R calculated by the reward calculation unit 151 may be a negative reward R when the manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object OB manufactured based on the determined target shape exceeds the allowable range, or the like, after the target shape of the additional portion AP is determined.

When the Q learning is advanced by using the reward R corresponding to the manufacturing error of the manufactured three-dimensional shaped object OB, the learning is guided in the direction of selecting the operation that obtains the higher reward R, and the function Q, which is the value of the operation value relating to the operation performed in the current state, is updated based on the state variable S and the determination data D, which are the states of the environment that change as a result of the selected operation being performed in the current state. By repeating this update, the function Q is rewritten to have a larger value in the more appropriate operation. In this way, the correlation between the current state of the unknown environment and the actions thereon is gradually known.

When predicting the amount of thermal deformation of a three-dimensional shaped object having through holes and recessed portions by using the finite element method, the boundary conditions set in the analysis model are complicated, and thus it is difficult to perform accurate prediction. In the machine learning device 100b of the present embodiment and the machine learning device 100 of the first embodiment, since the amount of thermal deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object is predicted by using machine learning without using the finite element method, it is possible to effectively suppress the manufacturing error of the three-dimensional shaped object having the through hole and the recessed portion from exceeding the allowable range.
